staticProof.status: verified by reading source for sDOLA (Etherscan-verified, not a proxy) and DolaSavings (not a proxy), and cross-checked by the fork harness
staticProof.perClientEquivalence: totalBalanceOf(c) = floor(V*p_c/td) >= p_c  iff  V >= td. So one client cannot be underwater unless the whole strategy is.
staticProof.deposit: s = floor(a*T/A), so the rate does not fall; V' >= floor(S*A'/T') + floor(s*A'/T') >= V + credited
staticProof.withdraw: r = floor(w*T/A) <= S because w <= p <= td <= V; the rate does not fall, so V' >= floor(S*A/T - w) = V - w >= td - w
staticProof.skim: sum of floored per-client shares; V' >= V - sum(surplus_i) >= td
staticProof.totalWithdraw_relinquish: reduce td by at least the value they remove
staticProof.sDolaRate: totalAssets = savings.balanceOf - streamed revenue. buyDBR adds X to both terms (net 0). The stream only decays over the week, and the rollover jumps upward. DolaSavings.balanceOf decreases only through the holder's own unstake. DolaSavings.sweep cannot touch staked DOLA. sDOLA.sweep cannot reach the savings stake. No gov lever lowers A/T. solmate rounding favours the vault.
staticProof.onlyBreakingPath: AYieldStrategy.emergencyWithdraw (onlyOwner) removes shares without writing principal down. This is a knowing owner action (Law 3).
